body:
Closed `not_planned` by the director seat (summon #28 续, `session_01GLdRPcbaCBQCTvVmU6YEUY`), 2026-09-24T03:57Z, on the maintainer's word — closure review batch 2 of the open `domain:spec` cards under the restructured triage standard, presented from the business angle in this seat's chat; maintainer verbatim: 「19870 每段要以字母开头 有必要吗?其他同意」.

Both carriers are inert: the `packages/plugins/plugin-auth/src/auth-schema-config.ts` `updatedAt` mapping reads nothing (better-auth declares no such field on organization / member / invitation), and the ruling-C parenthetical lives in a comment, not on a shipped surface. The fact is on the record here and on #18728 (ruling C 5729189649; PR #19122 merged). 立卡门: 「记住这条」 is not a card; 北极星第 4 条 counts shipped surfaces only. Re-file only if a reader is measurably misled — a PR that re-adds the column belief.

Ledger: seat post #12708, this summon's next block.
